questions.stem: At an experience-modification discussion, a supervisor proposes: "Decide coverage solely from whether the employee clocked in electronically". The underlying case is: An employee is injured during an activity loosely connected to work but outside the normal location and schedule. What framework should guide the initial claim analysis? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Accept the claim automatically because the person was still an employee
Decide coverage solely from whether the employee clocked in electronically
Deny the claim automatically because it occurred away from the main facility
Evaluate whether the injury arose out of and occurred in the course of employment under the applicable jurisdiction’s tests and exceptions
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Compensability commonly turns on the relationship between the employment and the activity, time, place, purpose, and recognized exceptions—not one fact alone.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Accept the claim automatically because the person was still an employee' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling arising out of and course of employment principle.
The proposed response 'Decide coverage solely from whether the employee clocked in electronically' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling arising out of and course of employment principle.

The proposed response 'Deny the claim automatically because it occurred away from the main facility' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling arising out of and course of employment principle.

questions.stem: At a compensability question, a supervisor proposes: "Keep the employee off work until capable of every preinjury task". The underlying case is: A recovering employee can perform meaningful duties within medical restrictions. Which program approach is most effective? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Develop a medically consistent transitional-duty plan with clear tasks, communication, supervision, and periodic review
Assign busywork unrelated to restrictions or organizational needs
Keep the employee off work until capable of every preinjury task
Pressure the employee to exceed restrictions to shorten claim duration
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Well-designed transitional work supports recovery and function while respecting restrictions. It should be productive, communicated, and regularly reevaluated.
